caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object divided into fifteen circular sections arranged in a 3 by 5 grid. Each circular section contains a relief image encircled by a braided or laurel-wreath border. The images within the circles include various figures and objects: the top row contains a standing human figure, a structure with columns resembling a temple or building, and a reclining human figure; the second row contains three floral or plant motifs with different branching patterns; the third row includes another structure resembling a building with multiple stories, a human or animal figure in action, and another structure that appears to have towers; the fourth row contains three quadruped animals in differing poses; the bottom row has a human or angelic figure with wings, a ship with a sail, and an object resembling a cornucopia or container. The overall coloration is grayscale, with dark and light shading highlighting the reliefs and contours of the designs, and the object is framed by a slightly raised border. The background of the drawing is a plain, lighter rectangle set against an even lighter, nearly white, outer background.
title: Springerle Mold
